name: Kota Stone
intro: Kota stone is a fine-grained natural limestone from Rajasthan: muted blue-grey, green-grey or brown, with no veining and a calm, even texture. It is laid as jointed slabs for hard-wearing floors in homes, verandas, staircases, godowns, parking and outdoor paths. Shade varies by quarry lot, so ask us for photos of the current lot.
enquiryNote: Ask for trade rate. Quoted by slab thickness and finish.
seoTitle: Kota Stone Flooring in Karamadai, Coimbatore
seoDescription: Kota stone in blue, brown and beige for homes, verandas, godowns and parking, quoted by thickness and finish. Karamadai yard on Mettupalayam Main Road.
